deliverables.purpose: 产品事实、页面任务、目标用户、内容边界、统一信息架构、设计方向与保真度映射。
真实公开研究范围、已验证事实、分析归纳、证据缺口与页面可用结论。
逐页打开的公开来源、时间、支持主张、局限与截图关联。
低保真线框 HTML：信息架构、模块顺序、层级、CTA 和交互状态，不追求最终视觉。
中保真结构稿：同一内容和流程，加入设计 token、真实文案、组件状态与清晰布局。
高保真可运行 HTML：完整样式、交互、响应式、可访问性和克制动画；不伪装未实现的后端。
公开来源、图片归属、本地渲染命令结果、三个视口截图观察、修订与未验证边界。
仅保存本轮 Playwright 已返回、Read 已查看并记录来源的公开网页证据截图。
仅保存当前会话已生成 HTML 的本地 Chromium QA 截图。

fidelityLevels.low: 线框级：保留相同页面结构、内容标签与主要操作，不强行使用品牌视觉。
fidelityLevels.medium: 结构化草稿：保留相同页面结构、真实或明确标注的演示文案，展示组件状态和布局节奏。
fidelityLevels.high: 可点击视觉原型：保留相同信息架构和关键交互，加入完整 CSS、JS、响应式和可访问性。

highFidelityBaseline.designCanvas: 1920px reference canvas; content max-width 1200px; first viewport target at most 960px tall
highFidelityBaseline.typography: Chinese-first font stack beginning with Microsoft YaHei; base text at least 16px unless a caption requires smaller accessible treatment
requiredInteractions: visible hover and keyboard focus for primary CTAs
working FAQ accordion if FAQ exists
preferredSectionsForProductLanding: L03-L05 2-3 alternating features or grounded scenario
L07 proof or clearly marked demo / transparent limitations
highFidelityBaseline.technology: Self-contained browser-runnable HTML5 with inline or local CSS/JS and authorized assets. Use native CSS/JS animation; no external CDN dependencies or React-only Framer Motion imports. PrototypePreview blocks external network resources.

paletteConfirmation.options: 2-3 product-specific palettes with HEX and usage; allow Other/custom

overview.imageBoundary: PNG is a flattened HTML rendering, not image generation or editable Figma layers

evidenceBoundary.demoContentRule: Only use invented content when the user explicitly allows demo copy; label it visibly as 演示占位/待替换 and never present it as a real testimonial or business fact.
screenshotArchiveRequires: actual Playwright screenshot path for the exact public URL
source URL, title, capture time, relative path, purpose and alt text recorded
evidenceBoundary.localQaBoundary: PrototypePreview renders only HTML and local assets in the current Expert session workDir, blocks network resources and returns run-scoped imgs/qa/<runId>/ screenshots. It must not start a server, expose a public URL, browse arbitrary local paths, or relax public Playwright URL restrictions.

publicResearch: Every material external claim traces to opened public source or is labeled user-provided / demo / unverified.
A search-results page is not final evidence.
localHtmlQa: Use PrototypePreview, never Bash or public Playwright, to render the generated local HTML. Await the structured receipt and Read its exact unique PNG paths; HTML/PNG/review hashes must match the final revision.
Read every final high-fidelity QA screenshot before claiming visual verification.
Render low and mid prototypes at least once at desktop width to catch missing local assets.
If a visible defect is found, revise the affected HTML and rerender before delivery.
Call the result responsive viewport verification, not real-device or cross-platform testing.
Treat any 390 crop or horizontal overflow, 1024 disconnected/overlapped layout, 1440 decorative-only hero or buried CTA, error-page screenshot, or unread final revision as NEEDS WORK.
Evidence must be screenshot-observation-led: never claim visible or responsive merely because the intended CSS contains a media query.
Review every screen or substantive section; the three canonical first-viewport PNGs alone do not prove full-set coverage.
Normal vertical scrolling below the fold is not layout clipping; record unseen areas as not observed.
Do not infer click, keyboard, drag or reduced-motion execution from a still PNG; distinguish actual operation, code inspection and unverified behavior.

visualQualityContract.finalReceipt: prototype-evidence.md must record the chosen visual register, first-render defects, actual HTML corrections, and concrete 1440/1024/390 observations. It must state viewport-based visual QA, not real-device or cross-platform testing.
mandatoryFailureConditions: 390px: any clipped navigation, primary CTA, hero content, key visual, FAQ control, user-facing text, or horizontal scrolling caused by the high-fidelity layout
1024px: visibly disconnected, overlapped, or implausibly narrow desktop-derived content after responsive reflow
1440px: decorative-only hero that does not demonstrate a product action/state, visually buried primary CTA, or excessive empty gap before proof
any error-page screenshot, missing local resource, unread final screenshot, or screenshot from a non-final HTML revision
receiptAccuracyRules: describe what is visibly present in each named final PNG, not a CSS expectation
for 1440, 1024 and 390, state navigation/CTA visibility, content crop status, and the actual responsive arrangement
if any mandatory failure remains, record NEEDS WORK instead of a pass claim
record screen counts, approved scope exceptions, palette consent and per-screen coverage; no claim that instruction checks prove model output quality
